thread: Lyriel teaches Jaina the Farstrider one-handed bandage knot

evidence.clue: Jaina cannot tie a rag round Garran's arm one-handed (the end slides out; the half hitch drags off). She knows the bowline she tied at eight, the sheet bend, the clove hitch and the Kul Tiran gunners' breeching knot.

Lyriel puts her hands over Jaina's and teaches it: 'Loop over your thumb. Like that. Turn your wrist under. Tail through. Now take it in your teeth and set it.' Then 'Go on, Jaina. Bite it. It won't bite you back.' (first use of 'Jaina').

Jaina pulls the knot out and does it herself ('Again'): the loop slides off the stiff thumb, she swears in gunners' language, tries again further down the thumb root, wrist under, tail through with two fingertips; the knot closes flat and small and holds.
Lyriel: 'All of us. In the first year. You do it with the left until you can, and then they make you do it with the right... so we can patch our own mistakes.'

She ties the cooper's boy's dressing herself (lopsided but held; 'Did you just *bite* my bandage?'). At night Lyriel rebinds Jaina's hand and ties the same knot on her ('Not on your own hand, you can't. Not yet. Tomorrow.'). At dawn Jaina re-ties Garran's bandage unaided with the loop held at the root of her thumb.
Brask's ledger: Lyriel says 'put that one of us ties a good knot, Captain, if there's room on the line', glancing at Cyndia.

readerKnows: Jaina can now tie it on others; she cannot yet tie it on her own hand; the knot stands for her being able to patch a mistake.
povCharacterKnows: Jaina: wants this more than anything since Dalaran; intends to tie the next one on her own hand if it takes all afternoon.
notes: Plan: 'a ranger's knot in her hands that Lyriel taught her' is a locked chapter-4 fact. Callback available (her own hand; a later knot). Keep Jaina's hands damaged.
